instruction.text: The recipe tells you what you will need. Find and select the eggs to hear which ingredients you need for scrambled eggs.

end.text:
In order to serve one person, you will need:
- two eggs
- one tablespoon of milk
- two tablespoons of butter
- a pinch of salt and pepper
end.sound: In order to serve one person, you will need two eggs, one tablespoon of milk, two tablespoons of butter, and a pinch of salt and pepper.

instruction.text: After the list of ingredients, a recipe explains all the steps you need to follow. Find and choose the pan in the recipe book to continue to the steps.

atoms.text: Step 1: Crack the eggs and whisk them lightly with the milk.
Step 2: Ask a grown-up to heat a pan and melt the butter.
Step 3: Pour the mixture into the pan.
Step 4: After the mixture has sat in the pan for about 20 seconds, start stirring. Wait a few seconds before stirring it again.
Step 5: The scrambled eggs have finished cooking when they are a little bit runny, but mostly firm.
